note: ⛔ SNG-490 + Death audit 2026-08-23. DEATH'S OBSCURE CRAFTS, both halves. Soul Stare — the Ashwarden's, a resistance-drop that sets up the tradition's own ending crafts. Public Grief — the Threnodist's, authored because Threnodist was one of 20 traditions with NO obscure and the ONLY one whose own tenet made the gap a contradiction: a people who hold feeling is the only true knowing cannot hide behind a false feeling, so they hide behind a real one turned all the way up. ⚠️ FILED HERE, NOT IN reach_emotional_logical.json, because Soul Stare set the precedent — Death's obscure crafts live together so an audit looking for them finds them.

abilities.name: Soul Stare
abilities.narrationHints: They meet your eyes and hold them a beat too long, and you understand — not as a threat, as a fact — that you are a thing which ends, and roughly how.
abilities.description: Meet something's gaze and show it its own ending — it stops being able to read you, and what it was relying on to keep it whole stops working as well.
abilities.notFor: Anything you cannot see; a foe already blinded or looking away; killing — this shows an ending, it does not cause one.

crit.success: They see it whole, and what they were holding themselves together with goes with it.

mechanic.note: conceal/obscure, declared in the SENSE slot. ⛔ THE RESIST DROP IS THE CRAFT'S COMBAT VALUE AND IT SCALES: −2 / −3 / −4 by rank, for the duration. Per `impositionOf`, `threshold = base + targetResist × perResist − (rank−1) × perRank` — SO LOWERING targetResist MAKES THE NEXT IMPOSITION LAND, and Soul Stare is a setup craft for everything else the tradition does. ⚠️ `mechanic.resistDrop` IS NOT READ BY ANY ENGINE PATH YET — `resistBonus` exists on the intercept path only. The numbers are authored here and stated in `plainly` so a GM can rule on them; see the note to CCode. ⛔ AND IT IS `conceal`, NOT `deceive`: per function_vocabulary, deceive shows what is FALSE and conceal hides what is TRUE. This craft shows a FACT — 'not as a threat, as a fact, that you are a thing which ends' — and hides you behind it. It is the second Death obscure that works by TELLING THE TRUTH; `public_grief` is the other. ⛔ SENSE-SLOT USABLE AND VERIFIED: `isObscureDecl` reads `obscure: true` and returns true for this craft, so it is declarable in the sense step and the tie rule applies (a tie goes to the obscurer). ⚠️ `sense: null` was authored on it and has been REMOVED — an explicit null reads as a deliberate 'no' rather than 'not applicable', and this craft is not a READ, it is an OBSCURE that happens to work by showing something.

bounds.text: ⛔ THEY MUST BE ABLE TO SEE YOUR EYES. A helm, a turned back or a blindfold ends it
⚠️ IT SHOWS AN ENDING; IT DOES NOT CAUSE ONE
⛔ IT IS `conceal`, NOT `deceive` — everything it shows is TRUE. That is why a thing that cannot be lied to is still stopped by it
they know exactly what you did and who did it

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action declared in the SENSE slot. It denies their read of you AND DROPS THEIR RESISTANCE so the next thing that reaches them lands harder — RESIST −2 at r1, −3 at r2, −4 at r3, for the duration. r2 reaches any living thing; r3 reaches anything with an essence, including a set body.

tree.name: Soul Stare
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE IN THE SENSE SLOT TO DENY THEIR READ — a person who is being shown their own death is not reading you. ⚠️ AND IT DROPS THEIR RESISTANCE BY 2 for the duration: whatever they were holding themselves together with counts for less against the next thing that reaches them.
tree.cannot: A person, and they must be able to see your eyes. One per sense action.
tree._imposes: ⛔ SNG-513. A person shown their own death is not reading you.

tree.name: Every Living Thing
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE IN THE SENSE SLOT. Show ANY LIVING THING its own ending — a warhorse, a hound, a beast, a thing grown rather than born. It stops reading you, and ⚠️ THE RESISTANCE DROP DEEPENS TO 3.
tree.cannot: It must be alive and it must be able to see you.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS TARGETS BEYOND PEOPLE. Any living thing — a warhorse, a hound, a beast, a thing grown rather than born. It stops, and what it relied on gives.

tree.name: Everything Has an Address
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE IN THE SENSE SLOT. Show ANYTHING WITH AN ESSENCE its own end — a construct, A SET BODY, a warded door, a working someone is sustaining. What is not alive still finishes. ⚠️ RESISTANCE DROPS BY 4.
tree.cannot: It must have been made, grown, or bound by someone. Raw stone has no address to show.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS THE UNLIVING. Everything has an essence and every essence can be shown its end — a construct, a set body, a warded door, a working someone is sustaining, a bound thing. ⚠️ WHAT IS NOT ALIVE STILL FINISHES.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-490. Erik: 'SOUL STARE could be an obscure skill rank 1, plus it would DROP THEIR RESISTANCE. r2 would have a similar effect but on ANY LIVING ENTITY. r3 would work on ANYTHING — everything has an essence (ADDRESS).'
⚠️ DEATH HAD NO OBSCURE. And the rank ladder is TARGET CLASS, not power: person → living → anything with an address, which is the Ashwarden thesis that everything finishes.
⛔ THE RESISTANCE DROP IS THE SECOND HALF AND IT MAKES THIS A SETUP FOR THE WHOLE TRADITION — Hastened Grey, Draw Down and Cut Thread all land harder on something that has just been shown its ending.
abilities._reviewed_20260824: ⛔ `deceive` -> `conceal`. Per function_vocabulary, DECEIVE SHOWS WHAT IS FALSE and CONCEAL HIDES WHAT IS TRUE — and this craft shows a FACT and hides you behind it. It was tagged as lying while being the one obscure in the game that works by telling the truth. ⚠️ Second Death obscure to do that; `public_grief` opens a REAL grief for the same reason. ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-24: 'make sure you remember to include the RESIST DROPS and how they SCALE WITH RANK UP' — now −2 / −3 / −4, stated at every rank, in `plainly`, and in `mechanic.resistDrop`. It is the craft's actual combat value and was previously unnumbered at r1, vague at r2 and absent at r3. ⚠️ `operativeAxis` was the bare STRING 'death_life' — an axis of the WORLD, not of the craft. ⛔ r3 ALREADY REACHED UNDEAD ('a set body') before §48 existed; nothing added.

abilities.name: Public Grief
abilities.narrationHints: She wept, and it was real, and it told them nothing. The grief-house is loud for a reason.
abilities.description: Open a grief wide enough that everything else you are goes unread underneath it. ⚠️ THE COVER IS THE SIZE OF THE FEELING, NOT ITS HONESTY — a real grief is simply the easiest one to open that wide, and the one that costs you something to use.
abilities.notFor: ⚠️ A HEART WITH NOTHING TO OPEN — you need a grief big enough to hide behind, whatever its source. Concealing a THING, a place, or a body (that is Umbracraft). And it does not make you unseen — you are extremely visible. You are simply unreadable.

crit.success: The grief is so entirely true that reading you becomes indecent — they stop trying, and afterwards they cannot say why they looked away.
crit.failure: The grief runs past where you meant to stop it. They do not learn what you were hiding. They learn that you are hiding something, and that it costs you.

bounds.text: ⛔ IT HIDES A FEELING, NEVER A FACT. What you know, what you carry and where you stand are all still plainly readable
⚠️ You are not concealed — you are the loudest thing in the room. Only what you MEAN is covered
⚠️ It costs what grieving costs. You do not get the grief back afterwards

abilities.plainly: A self-only conceal that hides your emotional state, declared in the sense slot. Ranks: r1 hides your own intent, r2 covers another person beside you, r3 covers the room and denies the read outright.

tree.name: Open Weeping
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE OBSCURE IN THE SENSE SLOT. Open a grief and your intent goes unread beneath it — anyone reading your feeling-state finds the grief, entire, and nothing under it.
tree.cannot: One person: you. And you give up your own read to do it — you are grieving, not watching.

tree.name: Shared Mourning
tree.grants: Draw someone beside you into the mourning and cover them too. ⚠️ THEY DO NOT HAVE TO BE GRIEVING — yours is loud enough for both, which is what a grief-house is FOR.
tree.cannot: They must be within arm's reach and willing to be held. It covers what they FEEL, never what they say or do.

tree.name: Grief-House
tree.grants: ⛔ THE FULL VOICE. The mourning fills the space and every read attempted inside it comes back with the grief and nothing else — and per the tie rule, a tie here is yours.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ It ends when you stop, and you cannot hold it and act. The room knows exactly where you are the whole time.

abilities._authored: ⛔ AEVI 2026-08-23, Death audit. Threnodist was 1 of 20 traditions with no obscure craft. ⚠️ CORRECTED SAME DAY (Erik): my first version made 'the grief must be REAL and YOURS' a HARD BOUND and justified it with 'a people who hold feeling is the only true knowing cannot hide behind a false one.' ⛔ THAT WAS OVER-AUTHORING — the tenet is an EPISTEMOLOGY (how a Threnodist knows) and I promoted it to a PROHIBITION on what one may do. ⚠️ It also foreclosed a braid Erik wants open: FALSECRAFT (veilwright `deceive`) × a Threnodist obscure is the false-feeling version of this craft, and my rule had made it illegal by fiat. The craft is `conceal` because THIS one opens a feeling rather than fabricating one — not because the tradition is incapable of the other.
abilities._challengeTypesNormalised_20260824: ⛔ I INTRODUCED NON-CANONICAL TYPES DURING THE DEATH WALKTHROUGH AND THE LINT CAUGHT ME. The canonical set is FIGHT · SOCIAL · INVESTIGATE · PUZZLE · SURVIVE · EXPLORE · STEALTH · CHASE · DUEL · TRAVEL · CREATE · DEFEND. ⚠️ I authored INVESTIGATION, ENDURANCE, INTELLECTUAL, HARDSHIP and COMBAT — plausible English, not the vocabulary. Seven of the eight crafts carrying them were mine, from this session. Normalised ['SOCIAL', 'INVESTIGATION', 'STEALTH'] -> ['SOCIAL', 'INVESTIGATE', 'STEALTH'].

_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
_sng513: ⛔ SNG-513: `imposes` and `ongoingHarm` authored. Both readers were live and unfed — CCode named the fields rather than authoring content. ⚠️ `onCrit` IS ESCALATE: a crit imposes a DIFFERENT, stronger condition. `slain` is refused at all three doors — a craft is not a situation.
_sng523:
⛔ SNG-523: `mechanic.crit` authored. ⚠️ `critFor` HAS EXISTED, WITH A PER-CRAFT CAP AND A STRING SHORTHAND FOR AUTHORS, AND HAS NEVER HAD AN INPUT — 0 of 373. Every critical in the game was generic.
⛔ BOTH HALVES AUTHORED: `success` is what the craft's best case LOOKS LIKE; `failure` is its disaster. ⚠️ MOST CARRY TEXT ONLY — `chance` is opt-in and shifts nothing unless asked for, so a craft can say what its disaster looks like without claiming it happens more often.
